definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese strategy board game similar to chess, played on a 9×9 board with 20 pieces per player.

examples.japanese: {将棋|しょうぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指|さ}す→指す：02056_sasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.notes: 将棋を指す is the correct verb collocation

examples.english: My grandfather taught me how to play shogi.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Shogi is often called "Japanese chess" but differs significantly from Western chess. A unique feature is that captured pieces can be returned to the board as your own pieces.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {将棋|しょうぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指|さ}す→指す：02056_sasu⟧ (to play shogi) - NOT {将棋|しょうぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧
- {将棋|しょうぎ}⟦{盤|ばん}→盤：18576_ban⟧ (shogi board)
- {将棋|しょうぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{駒|こま}→駒：07119_koma⟧ (shogi pieces)
- {将棋|しょうぎ}⟦{棋士|きし}→棋士：27809_kishi⟧ (professional shogi player)
- {将棋|しょうぎ}⟦{道場|どうじょう}→道場：14326_doujou⟧ (shogi training hall)

SIMILAR GAMES:
- ⟦{囲碁|いご}→囲碁：18035_igo⟧ - Go (another traditional Japanese board game)
- ⟦チェス→チェス：11040_chesu⟧ - chess (Western chess)
